errors.evidence: The description states the range of the left y-axis (Efficacy_top) is 80 to 95. However, the data shown on the plot extends below 80 (to approximately 78) and above 95 (to approximately 97.5). The stated range only reflects the tick mark labels, not the full range of the data series.

The description states the range of the right y-axis (noise_E) is 1 to 5. However, the data shown on the plot extends below 1 (to approximately 0.8) and above 5 (to approximately 5.4). The stated range only reflects the tick mark labels, not the full range of the data series.

The description states that the 'AlphaEdit noise_E' line starts at a value of 0.8 at 500 edits. According to the plot, the value at 500 edits is approximately 1.5. The value 0.8 corresponds to the first data point, which is at an x-coordinate of approximately 300, not 500.
